def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 8 for v in row)]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 8 for r in range(h))]
    row_spans = []
    start = 0
    for r in sep_rows:
        if start < r:
            row_spans.append((start, r))
        start = r + 1
    if start < h:
        row_spans.append((start, h))
    col_spans = []
    start = 0
    for c in sep_cols:
        if start < c:
            col_spans.append((start, c))
        start = c + 1
    if start < w:
        col_spans.append((start, w))

    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    marks = {}
    for ri, (r0, r1) in enumerate(row_spans):
        for ci, (c0, c1) in enumerate(col_spans):
            colors = {grid[r][c] for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1) if grid[r][c] not in (0, 8)}
            for color in colors:
                marks.setdefault(color, []).append((ri, ci))

    painted = {}
    for color, pts in marks.items():
        for i, (r1, c1) in enumerate(pts):
            for r2, c2 in pts[i + 1:]:
                if r1 == r2:
                    for c in range(min(c1, c2), max(c1, c2) + 1):
                        painted[(r1, c)] = painted.get((r1, c), set()) | {color}
                if c1 == c2:
                    for r in range(min(r1, r2), max(r1, r2) + 1):
                        painted[(r, c1)] = painted.get((r, c1), set()) | {color}
    for (ri, ci), colors in painted.items():
        value = 6 if 2 in colors and 3 in colors else next(iter(colors))
        r0, r1 = row_spans[ri]
        c0, c1 = col_spans[ci]
        for r in range(r0, r1):
            for c in range(c0, c1):
                out[r][c] = value
    return out
